config.label: API key for HTTP authentication
config.description: API key for HTTP authentication. Required to bind the HTTP transport or the dashboard beyond loopback (0.0.0.0, a LAN address, a container): without it the server refuses to start

config.description: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)
